answer: An attacker minting N fake participants must lock N bonds; if any collude, slashing burns their stake. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is tying each agent reputation slot to a staked bond plus a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, so forging identities costs real capital. Like layers of shale resisting erosion, or a saffron dye that permanently marks fabric, the bond makes identity costly and traceable. Peers verify reputation through a narrow inlet of trusted attestations, capping sybil gains. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
